notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's first result, "thief" (id 3766, released 2014-02-25, Eidos Montreal), is the 2014 game, not "Thief: The Dark Project" (1998, a separate RAWG entry). No StrategyWiki page under "Thief (2014)": StrategyWiki's "Thief" is a series category page that links to "Thief (2014)", but that page is not created, so nothing was used. thief.fandom.com answers the API: "Thief (2014)" redirects to "Thief (reboot)", with about 77 linked pages; its summary says the game was first labelled "THI4F". Names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 37 Steam achievements is hidden. Nine achievements mark the Prologue and Chapters One to Eight, so the story is split into two chapters. "Two Faced" (uncovered Lyegrove's secret, 30%) is placed with the early chapters because its unlock rate sits between Chapters Three and Four; that is a judgement call. "Happy Birthday" ("Sweet sixteen. Snuff said.", 41%) does not say what it needs, so it sits in the skills chapter as a placeholder.
